assertions: The retrieved live production backup matched its own manifest SHA-256 and byte length and the container's recorded last-success SHA-256 before any use.
The capture recorded the source unchanged across the whole operation (identical before/after SHA-256, main file not modified during capture).
The produced snapshot carries no WAL side files, is 0600 and opens in journal_mode=delete.
Restored-source integrity checks pass: PRAGMA quick_check ok, zero foreign-key violations, page count and freelist recorded, application/data/user versions recorded.
Schema inventory is complete and drift-free: 35 tables, 14 indexes, 2 triggers, no missing or extra objects, schema head 8.

Every table and every field is classified: 37,409 fields classified, 0 unclassified, 0 accepted-unknown; source fingerprint b202ff21... binds the reader version, fixed clock, file hash, schema head and all eight state roots / 35 table roots.

The live source contains the real V4 shape rather than the empty fixture: 2 accounts with wallets/ratings/history, 2 linked identities, 2 email credentials, 2 profile saves, 2 social command outcomes, 48 economy commands, 7 party commands, 1 party room, 20 sessions, 1 presence row, 3 mail-budget buckets, 2 sent outbox jobs, 5,000 support events and the 8-row source migration ledger.
